scope: Starter asset/content pack validation only; not Flutter application validation.
checks: All IDs and full caption pairs unique
All referenced assets and source SVG files exist
All stickers decode at 512x512 with transparency
All manifest asset SHA-256 hashes match
SVG sources contain no rendered caption text or external image elements
Default caption IDs resolve and safe-text zones fit within the canvas
notPerformed: Mobile permissions and share sheet testing
